workflow.zh: 工作流与更新表面搜索

world.zh: 世界模型与具身持续适应

purpose.zh: Agent 修复当前失败后常直接提交更新，却不检查旧能力和圈外任务是否退化。
purpose.en: Agents often commit an update after fixing the current failure without checking regressions on mastered and out-of-loop tasks.

core_idea.zh: 把每次更新视为带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进；仅在隔离回归集通过后 commit，否则 rollback。
core_idea.en: Treat every update as constrained policy improvement; commit only after isolated non-regression, cost, and safety tests, otherwise roll back.

rationale.zh: 每次更新同时包含收益和回退风险；自进化应被写成带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进。
rationale.en: Every update carries gain and regression risk; self-evolution should be constrained policy improvement.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“把每次更新视为带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进；仅在隔离回归集通过后 commit，否则 rollback。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Treat every update as constrained policy improvement; commit only after isolated non-regression, cost, and safety tests, otherwise roll back., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 直接研究 ICLR 关心的学习动力学：哪些更新被接受、为何多轮改进不坍塌、收益能否圈外泛化。
importance.en: This directly studies learning dynamics, multi-round stability, and out-of-loop generalization.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“全部接受、仅按当前任务收益接受、置信度门控、固定非回退阈值、等预算随机更新。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Accept-all, current-task-gain filtering, confidence gates, fixed non-regression thresholds, and equal-budget random updates., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: AFlow 搜索工作流、WebRL 控制策略漂移，但没有统一的跨更新表面 commit/rollback 规则。
collision_boundary.en: AFlow searches workflows and WebRL controls policy drift, but neither provides a unified cross-surface commit/rollback rule.

hypothesis.zh: 固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。
hypothesis.en: Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.

strongest_baseline.zh: 全部接受、仅按当前任务收益接受、置信度门控、固定非回退阈值、等预算随机更新。
strongest_baseline.en: Accept-all, current-task-gain filtering, confidence gates, fixed non-regression thresholds, and equal-budget random updates.

pilot.zh: 在 ALFWorld、WebArena-Lite、MM-Vet 上，以 2 GPU、36 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
pilot.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on ALFWorld, WebArena-Lite, MM-Vet with two open models and at least two domains within 2 GPUs and 36 GPU-hours.

decisive_metric.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
decisive_metric.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

stop_condition.zh: 若“固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

budget.training: Freeze the foundation model; update only prompts, memory, workflows, routers, or modules below 50M parameters.

finding.zh: AFlow 搜索工作流、WebRL 控制策略漂移，但没有统一的跨更新表面 commit/rollback 规则。

finding.zh: 覆盖 3 类任务域。

finding.zh: 必须逐轮报告收益、最坏回退和被拒绝更新。

finding.zh: 环境真值、工具执行或异构 Critic 必须提供独立证据。

finding.zh: 上限 2 GPU、36 GPU 小时。
finding.en: Cap: 2 GPUs and 36 GPU-hours.

experiment_protocol.critic_or_verifier: Frozen heterogeneous open-weight critic plus environment/tool ground truth whenever available.

commercial_api_role.zh: 仅作为固定版本可选上界或最多 200 次审计 Judge；核心结论不得依赖。

discovery.en: Use 100-200 training examples per main domain for phenomenon confirmation only.

calibration.zh: 另取不重叠的 100–200 个样本冻结阈值和至多三组超参数。

test.zh: 官方测试集或至少 500 个隔离样本；测试期间禁止修改更新规则。
test.en: Use official tests or at least 500 isolated examples; update rules stay frozen during testing.

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。

setup.zh: 在 ALFWorld、WebArena-Lite、MM-Vet 上，以 2 GPU、36 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。

purpose.zh: 记忆压缩倾向保留共识摘要，丢掉能推翻规则的少数反证。
purpose.en: Memory consolidation preserves consensus summaries and drops rare counterevidence that can overturn a rule.

core_idea.zh: 固定容量下联合优化代表性和反证保留，保存能改变结论的最小反例集。

rationale.zh: 持久记忆需要识别干扰、保存反例、表达适用边界，并随任务漂移修订。
rationale.en: Persistent memory must detect interference, retain counterexamples, encode applicability, and adapt under drift.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“固定容量下联合优化代表性和反证保留，保存能改变结论的最小反例集。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。

importance.zh: 记忆是最常见的低资源更新表面，也是负迁移最容易被平均准确率掩盖的地方。

external_reviews.finding: The general memory-consolidation space is crowded, and recent systems already revisit discarded evidence, compress memories, or retrieve counterevidence. Nevertheless, a standalone thesis survives after narrowing: under an identical storage and retrieval budget, memory value is defined causally by whether retaining or removing an item changes a downstream conclusion. Optimizing a minimal conclusion-changing set is more specific than coverage, similarity, contradiction detection, or full-history revisitation.
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the broad three-domain pilot with a fixed-capacity benchmark containing oracle-verifiable conclusion-changing evidence and compare against recent consolidation systems at identical stored and retrieved token budgets.

closest_work.title: Look Back to Reason Forward: Revisitable Memory for Long-Context LLM Agents
SimpleMem: Efficient Lifelong Memory for LLM Agents
From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-term Dialogue

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Fixed-capacity consolidation optimized for causal conclusion-flip value: retain the smallest counterevidence set whose removal would change the agent's later conclusion, rather than maximizing semantic coverage or generic retrieval relevance.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: ReMemR1-style revisitable memory combined with contradiction-aware retrieval, constrained to the same persistent-memory capacity, retrieved tokens, model calls, and context length.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct sequential tasks where a rare later observation invalidates an earlier rule, impose a fixed memory capacity K, and compare FIFO, similarity retention, summary memory, SimpleMem, ReMemR1, contradiction retrieval, and conclusion-flip consolidation on retention of oracle counterevidence, final decision accuracy, and negative transfer to unseen task templates.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if conclusion-flip consolidation does not reduce final conclusion errors or negative transfer relative to the strongest matched-capacity baseline on a second model and held-out task family, or if its gain disappears when stored and retrieved tokens are matched.
unknowns: A reliable conclusion-change oracle for open-ended ALFWorld and Video-MME trajectories is not specified.
It is unknown whether the minimal conclusion-changing set can be approximated without costly repeated counterfactual inference.
The feasibility of covering knowledge, interactive-agent, and multimodal domains within 20 GPU-hours is unverified.

purpose.en: Two individually useful updates can interfere when composed; individual regression tests cannot predict composition.

importance.en: The ICLR contribution is learning compositional, generalizable, stable structure-update rules.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“固定工作流、Prompt 搜索、AFlow、随机图编辑、贪心修改、等成本 MCTS。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Fixed workflows, prompt search, AFlow, random graph edits, greedy edits, and equal-cost MCTS., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: 工作流模块化研究结构依赖，但更新操作之间的语义干扰仍未系统建模。
collision_boundary.en: Workflow modularity studies structural dependencies, but semantic interference among updates remains under-modeled.

hypothesis.zh: 交互图应预测未见组合回退并找到更优提交顺序。
hypothesis.en: The interaction graph should predict unseen composition regressions and identify better commit orders.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定工作流、Prompt 搜索、AFlow、随机图编辑、贪心修改、等成本 MCTS。

decisive_metric.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
decisive_metric.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

external_reviews.finding: A narrow standalone thesis survives: predicting order-sensitive regressions among persistent agent updates is not covered by workflow search or module-composition work. The claim must be limited to unseen combinations of individually beneficial, versioned updates and distinguished from generic graph-performance prediction; a pairwise interaction graph alone is insufficient unless it also predicts held-out orders and higher-order compositions.
external_reviews.required_action: Freeze the update surface to versioned prompt, memory, or workflow commits and preregister held-out pair-order and three-update composition tests against a task-conditioned graph predictor at identical execution and testing budgets.

closest_work.title: AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space
Learning to Compose for Cross-domain Agentic Workflow Generation
GNNs as Predictors of Agentic Workflow Performances

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Predict semantic regression and commit-order effects for unseen compositions of individually useful persistent updates, rather than generating modules, recombining capabilities, or predicting the aggregate score of an already assembled workflow.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A task-conditioned FLORA-style GNN trained on the same composition tests, together with AgentSquare or AFlow search and exhaustive pairwise order checks constrained to the same total calls.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create individually beneficial prompt, memory, and workflow commits on ALFWorld; train on only a subset of edit pairs and orders; then, on a second frozen model and held-out task family, compare regression AUROC and final ordered-composition success against the FLORA-style predictor and equal-call exhaustive or random checks.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if, on the second model and task family, held-out regression AUROC is below 0.70 or improves by less than 0.03 over the strongest matched-budget predictor, or the selected commit order yields less than a 3-point success gain with a 95% confidence interval crossing zero.
unknowns: No official source located through 2026-08-01 explicitly evaluates order-sensitive composition of persistent prompt, memory, and workflow updates rather than module recombination or complete-workflow prediction.

rationale.zh: 每次更新同时包含收益和回退风险；自进化应被写成带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进。

method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Define a trust region for discrete agent updates using trajectory KL, action-edit distance, tool routing, and memory-retrieval shift., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

external_reviews.finding: A narrowed standalone thesis survives. TeamTR establishes trust-region control for sequential parameter updates in multi-agent LLMs, MAPRO invokes small prompt mutations as a heuristic trust region, and GRASP admits skill edits through a balanced held-out regression gate. None of the located work defines and validates an occupancy-level trust region for persistent nonparametric agent updates using trajectory, action, tool-routing, and retrieval distributions, then tests whether that distance predicts future regression better than textual edit size or current-task gain. ([arXiv][4])
external_reviews.required_action: Pre-register one nonparametric update surface and one independently sampled occupancy-divergence estimator before claiming a unified trust region across prompts, memories, and workflows.

closest_work.title: TeamTR: Trust-Region Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
MAPRO: Recasting Multi-Agent Prompt Optimization as Maximum a Posteriori Inference
GRASP: Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer for Self-Improving LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A behavior-space trust region for discrete, persistent, nonparametric updates, estimated from independent probe trajectories and used prospectively to constrain update admission rather than merely measuring textual change or imposing a held-out regression threshold.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: GRASP's balanced held-out probe and hard regression-budget gate, which directly tests whether an additional behavioral-shift estimator has predictive or decision value.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate the same candidate prompt or skill edits for every method, estimate each candidate's trajectory/action/tool-routing shift on a fixed independent probe set, and compare regression prediction plus the accepted-update utility-regression frontier against GRASP gating, textual edit distance, and current-task gain under identical calls.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if no proposed shift metric improves future-regression AUROC by at least 0.05 over the GRASP-style gate and reduces accepted-update regressions by at least 20% relative at matched retained utility on both the second model and second domain.
unknowns: Whether trajectory KL or action-edit estimates are stable with the small probe sample permitted by the 20 GPU-hour budget.
How heterogeneous trajectory, tool-routing, and memory-retrieval distances can be combined without tuning on the regression test distribution.
Whether a trust radius learned for one update surface transfers to another rather than requiring surface-specific calibration.

rationale.en: Persistent memory must detect interference, retain counterexamples, encode applicability, and adapt under drift.

external_reviews.finding: The memory-harm phenomenon, held-out continual-learning evaluation, NullMemory counterfactuals, and contamination-aware routing are already established. Novelty survives only as replicated entry-level causal credit followed by a persistent quarantine policy; the current auditor framing does not yet specify an identifiable learning rule or multi-round stability test.

track.zh: 世界模型与具身持续适应

purpose.zh: Agent 只从已执行轨迹学习，难以获得未执行但会导致不可逆损失的负经验。
purpose.en: Agents learn only from executed trajectories and miss counterfactual negative experience for irreversible actions.

core_idea.zh: 用世界模型生成受约束的未执行后果，仅在环境规则或模拟器可验证时写入风险记忆。
core_idea.en: Generate constrained unexecuted consequences and admit risk memories only when verified by environment rules or simulators.

rationale.zh: Agent 需要学习动作后的状态变化、不可逆后果和恢复边界，但更准的模型不一定改善决策。
rationale.en: Agents need action-conditioned dynamics, irreversible outcomes, and recovery boundaries, yet accuracy may not improve decisions.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“用世界模型生成受约束的未执行后果，仅在环境规则或模拟器可验证时写入风险记忆。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Generate constrained unexecuted consequences and admit risk memories only when verified by environment rules or simulators., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 世界模型把语言反思推进到可验证环境动态学习，并连接 Web、GUI 与具身场景。
importance.en: World models move reflection toward verifiable dynamics learning across web, GUI, and embodied settings.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“无世界模型、语言反思、WMA、一步转移模型、树搜索、随机风险惩罚。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with No world model, verbal reflection, WMA, one-step transitions, tree search, and random risk penalties., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: WMA 预测动作后果；本方法专注不可逆风险的可验证反事实经验。
collision_boundary.en: WMA predicts action outcomes; this focuses on verifiable counterfactual experience for irreversible risk.

hypothesis.zh: 验证后的反事实记忆应减少不可逆错误且不导致过度保守。
hypothesis.en: Verified counterfactual memory should reduce irreversible errors without excessive conservatism.

external_reviews.finding: World-model lookahead, episodic safety memory, and memory-guided counterfactual planning already cover most ingredients. A viable novelty boundary remains only if verified unexecuted consequences become persistent risk memories that improve later tasks after the simulator and extra lookahead calls are removed; the current formulation does not isolate that learning effect.
external_reviews.required_action: Narrow to one environment with an exact independent transition verifier and demonstrate a discovery-then-freeze protocol in which counterfactual risk memories are learned under a fixed simulator-call budget and evaluated with the simulator disabled.

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Verifier-approved negative experience for actions never executed in the real environment, persisted across episodes and shown to transfer with no world-model or simulator calls at evaluation.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Web Agents with World Models using online lookahead, plus episodic safety memory learned from executed unsafe trajectories.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In one sandbox with exact marked irreversible transitions, allow a fixed discovery budget of simulator calls to populate risk memory; freeze it and disable simulation at test, then compare memory-only, online world-model planning with matched amortized calls, executed-unsafe episodic memory, verbal reflection, and no memory on unseen tasks.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if frozen counterfactual memory fails on the second model to reduce irreversible errors by at least 20% over the strongest no-simulator baseline while keeping benign-task success within 5 percentage points, or if the effect disappears under matched total simulator calls.
unknowns: No official source found by the cutoff exactly combines verifier-approved unexecuted irreversible outcomes with persistent cross-episode risk memory and simulator-free evaluation.

external_reviews.finding: Cross-generation error amplification is important, but CREAM already addresses noisy, overconfident preference labels through cross-iteration reward consistency, while recursive-training work studies collapse prevention through self-verification. The surviving contribution is not generic confidence weighting; it must be an explicit parent-label dependency model whose propagated uncertainty predicts independently audited errors and improves persistent reward-model updates under identical label, call, token, and training budgets.
external_reviews.required_action: Produce a preregistered multi-round pilot that compares a formally specified lineage-confidence model against current-round confidence, CREAM-style consistency, and independent-judge calibration using exactly the same generated examples and evaluator calls.

direct_collision.surviving_difference: An explicit label-lineage graph with calibrated parent-to-child uncertainty propagation across multiple generations, rather than current-round filtering or pairwise cross-iteration consistency.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: CREAM-style cross-iteration consistency combined with an independently calibrated judge ensemble, using the same examples, labels, calls, and reward-model training tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Run four self-labeling generations on one preference dataset with two open model families; keep all generated pairs and judge calls fixed, update only the same sub-50M reward head, and compare unweighted labels, current-round confidence, CREAM consistency, and lineage confidence on held-out human-label error AUROC, calibration error, external preference accuracy, and round-by-round degradation.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if lineage confidence does not improve held-out label-error prediction and external preference accuracy over the strongest matched-budget baseline on the second model family or domain, with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals excluding any positive gain, or if improvement requires additional evaluator calls.

It is unverified that four meaningful reward-learning rounds across two model families fit within 24 GPU-hours.

external_reviews.finding: Frozen anchors, heterogeneous reward ensembles, and policy-feedback reward evolution already cover the proposal's principal components. A cross-version evaluation matrix is useful, but as written it is a hand-designed audit protocol rather than an identifiable learning contribution. The thesis becomes defensible only if actor-by-evaluator interaction residuals predict future external-quality failures and train a persistent gate that generalizes to unseen rounds or actors.
external_reviews.required_action: Implement a learned actor-version-by-evaluator-version interaction-residual gate and evaluate it on held-out future rounds against frozen rewards, latest-version pairing, and matched-call reward ensembles.

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A factorial cross-version actor-evaluator design that separates actor main effects, evaluator main effects, and pair-specific co-adaptation, then uses the interaction residual to block updates on unseen later rounds.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A frozen-anchor reward ensemble with heterogeneous judges and conservative disagreement gating, using exactly the same candidate responses and evaluator calls.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate three actor and evaluator versions, score the same response pool with the complete cross-version matrix, train a sub-50M gate only on rounds one and two, and compare its round-three reward-hacking detection and external-quality preservation against latest-pair scoring, a frozen reward model, ensemble disagreement, and random update blocking.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the interaction residual fails to predict held-out external-quality degradation better than evaluator disagreement, or if the learned gate does not reduce the external exploit gap on the second model or domain at identical judge-call and response budgets.
unknowns: It is unverified that measurable co-adaptation will emerge within three low-resource rounds when foundation-model weights are frozen.
The independence of the proposed heterogeneous judges and frozen anchors is not established.
No official source verifies that a small human audit can reliably distinguish pair-specific co-adaptation from ordinary evaluator noise at the proposed scale.

track.zh: 世界模型与具身持续适应

purpose.zh: 任务成功或重新加入轨迹不等于完整恢复，残余状态可能被写成成功经验。
purpose.en: Task success or trajectory rejoin does not imply full recovery, and residual states can be stored as success lessons.

core_idea.zh: 经验准入同时要求终点成功、持续重合和状态残差通过，并按恢复级别控制写入强度。
core_idea.en: Admission requires endpoint success, sustained rejoin, and residual-state checks, with update strength conditioned on recovery level.

rationale.zh: Agent 需要学习动作后的状态变化、不可逆后果和恢复边界，但更准的模型不一定改善决策。
rationale.en: Agents need action-conditioned dynamics, irreversible outcomes, and recovery boundaries, yet accuracy may not improve decisions.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“经验准入同时要求终点成功、持续重合和状态残差通过，并按恢复级别控制写入强度。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。

importance.zh: 世界模型把语言反思推进到可验证环境动态学习，并连接 Web、GUI 与具身场景。

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“无世界模型、语言反思、WMA、一步转移模型、树搜索、随机风险惩罚。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with No world model, verbal reflection, WMA, one-step transitions, tree search, and random risk penalties., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: 具身 continual learning 常按任务成功更新，过程残差与持久学习的关系仍不足。
collision_boundary.en: Embodied continual learning often updates from task success, leaving process residuals underexplored.

hypothesis.zh: 完整恢复轨迹应具有更高未来技能复用价值，残差轨迹更易造成负迁移。
hypothesis.en: Fully recovered trajectories should have higher future reuse value; residual trajectories should cause more negative transfer.

decisive_metric.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。

stop_condition.zh: 若“完整恢复轨迹应具有更高未来技能复用价值，残差轨迹更易造成负迁移。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。

finding.zh: 具身 continual learning 常按任务成功更新，过程残差与持久学习的关系仍不足。
finding.en: Embodied continual learning often updates from task success, leaving process residuals underexplored.

external_reviews.finding: The residual-recovery hypothesis may be novel, but the current mechanism is primarily a hand-built admission gate and leaves the persistent update surface unspecified. Dejavu already continually admits and retrieves successful embodied experiences, PEAM learns whether and when experience should be internalized, and ACE-Brain-0.5 combines progress and recovery monitoring with rollout-derived failure-recovery memory. The contribution must therefore be the prospective relationship between incomplete recovery and harmful future reuse, not the existence of another experience filter.
external_reviews.required_action: Fix the update surface to a bounded external experience memory and learn a recovery-completeness score from independently measured future reuse harm rather than hard-coding endpoint, rejoin, and residual checks.

closest_work.title: Dejavu: Towards Experience Feedback Learning for Embodied Intelligence
PEAM: Parametric Embodied Agent Memory through Contrastive Internalization of Experience in Minecraft
ACE-Brain-0.5: A Unified Embodied Foundational Model for Physical Agentic AI

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Prospectively test whether trajectories that achieve endpoint success but fail sustained-rejoin or residual-state criteria cause negative transfer, and scale persistent memory updates using an independently verified recovery level.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Dejavu's Experience Feedback Network with endpoint-success admission, matched memory capacity, retrieval calls, interactions, and foundation model, together with a PEAM-style parameterization-worthiness score.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In LIBERO perturbation episodes that all reach endpoint success, stratify trajectories using independently computed sustained-rejoin and residual-state probes, insert equal numbers into a fixed-size memory, and measure held-out future-task reuse harm against endpoint-only Dejavu and PEAM-style admission on a second VLA.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if recovery completeness predicts harmful reuse with AUROC below 0.65 on the second VLA and domain, or recovery-conditioned admission fails to improve held-out success by at least 3 points over endpoint-only admission under matched memory and calls.
unknowns: The public ACE-Brain-0.5 description does not specify whether recovery completeness gates memory admission or update magnitude.
The extent to which Dejavu admits partially recovered trajectories rather than only contextually successful experiences is not explicit in the official abstract.

external_reviews.finding: The broad curriculum claim is crowded. WebRL generates new tasks from unsuccessful attempts, DreamGym generates tasks that challenge the current policy, ATGen adversarially evolves automatically scored test cases, and formal counterexample work generates verifier-checked instances by deleting hypotheses. A thesis survives only around minimal single-constraint counterexamples to explicit agent rules and demonstrable boundary generalization rather than generic difficulty generation, failure replay, or adversarial task synthesis.
external_reviews.required_action: Restrict the pilot to one verifier-rich environment and define counterexample minimality operationally through constraint deletion or delta debugging against an explicit extracted policy rule.

closest_work.title: ATGen: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Test Case Generation
WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
Learning to Disprove: Formal Counterexample Generation with Large Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Extract an explicit behavioral rule from the current agent, synthesize an automatically verified task that violates exactly one rule condition, minimize the task under constraint deletion, and test transfer to held-out rule boundaries rather than neighboring generated tasks.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: ATGen's adversarial test generator matched for generated-task count, verifier calls, adapter updates, and curriculum rounds, with WebRL failure-derived task generation as a second reference.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In ALFWorld with programmatic success predicates, extract one explicit behavioral rule per failure, generate verifier-confirmed task variants, minimize each by deleting constraints, and train the same small adapter on equal-size curricula; compare held-out single-constraint boundary accuracy against ATGen and WebRL-style curricula on a second model.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if minimized counterexamples do not outperform equal-size ATGen or WebRL-style curricula by at least 5 points on held-out boundary tasks on the second model, or if gains vanish after lexical and structural near-duplicate removal.
unknowns: No official source located through 2026-08-01 reports the exact combination of implicit agent-rule extraction, single-constraint minimization, automatic verification, and cross-domain boundary transfer.
Automatic verification is not naturally available for all three proposed pilot domains, especially open-ended multimodal evaluation.

pilot.zh: 在 WorfBench、HumanEval、HotpotQA 上，以 1 GPU、16 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。

stop_condition.zh: 若“通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。

budget.training: Freeze the foundation model; update only prompts, memory, workflows, routers, or modules below 50M parameters.

finding.zh: WorfBench 提供结构评测；本方法把评测转为工作流准入机制。
finding.en: WorfBench evaluates structure; this converts evaluation into workflow admission.

finding.zh: ICLR 价值在于学习可组合、可泛化且稳定的结构更新规则。
finding.en: The ICLR contribution is learning compositional, generalizable, stable structure-update rules.

finding.zh: 覆盖 3 类任务域。
finding.en: Covers 3 task domains.

finding.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。

finding.zh: 必须逐轮报告收益、最坏回退和被拒绝更新。

external_reviews.finding: The proposed perturbations are not themselves novel: WorFBench evaluates held-out workflow generalization, RobustFlow trains workflow invariance to semantically equivalent instructions, and WorkflowPerturb applies controlled structural and description perturbations. A viable thesis remains only if the contribution is a calibrated pre-commit admission rule whose certificate predicts locked out-of-loop transfer better than ordinary validation, rather than another robustness test suite. ([OpenReview][1])
external_reviews.required_action: Define and calibrate a pre-commit acceptance statistic on independently generated workflow candidates, then validate it against future performance on unseen tool APIs and task-graph motifs under a matched total evaluation budget.

closest_work.title: Benchmarking Agentic Workflow Generation
RobustFlow: Towards Robust Agentic Workflow Generation
WorkflowPerturb: Calibrated Stress Tests for Evaluating Multi-Agent Workflow Metrics

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A calibrated decision rule for admitting a persistent workflow update, with certificate outcomes tied prospectively to transfer onto unseen but semantically equivalent tools and graph structures; existing work primarily benchmarks, measures, or trains robustness rather than validating this commit decision.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: AFlow-generated candidates selected by ordinary held-out utility augmented with RobustFlow-style paraphrase consistency and WorkflowPerturb-style structural stress scores.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate one fixed pool of AFlow workflow candidates, then compare utility-only selection, uncalibrated perturbation-score selection, and the proposed calibrated certificate on task renaming, API-equivalent tool substitution, and unseen graph motifs, charging every certification call and token equally.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if certificate selection fails to reduce locked-transfer regret by at least 10% relative to the strongest non-certificate selector on both the second model and second domain, or if the advantage disappears after certification calls are included in the budget.
unknowns: Whether the proposed tool substitutions can be automatically certified as capability-equivalent rather than merely similar in description.
Whether WorfBench, HumanEval, and HotpotQA can support one common executable workflow representation without introducing benchmark-specific adapters that dominate the result.
Whether enough independent workflow candidates and perturbation executions fit within the stated 16 GPU-hours.

purpose.en: Fixed evolution rounds waste calls on easy tasks and stop too early on difficult ones.

core_idea.zh: 学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。
core_idea.en: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost.

rationale.zh: 每次更新同时包含收益和回退风险；自进化应被写成带非回退、成本和安全约束的策略改进。
rationale.en: Every update carries gain and regression risk; self-evolution should be constrained policy improvement.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 直接研究 ICLR 关心的学习动力学：哪些更新被接受、为何多轮改进不坍塌、收益能否圈外泛化。
importance.en: This directly studies learning dynamics, multi-round stability, and out-of-loop generalization.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“全部接受、仅按当前任务收益接受、置信度门控、固定非回退阈值、等预算随机更新。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Accept-all, current-task-gain filtering, confidence gates, fixed non-regression thresholds, and equal-budget random updates., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: 现有 Agent 搜索通常固定预算或 patience，停止规则没有被当作学习对象。
collision_boundary.en: Agent search usually fixes budgets or patience; stopping itself is rarely treated as a learning problem.

hypothesis.zh: 控制器应在等效性能下减少至少 30% 调用，并能跨任务族迁移。
hypothesis.en: The controller should save at least 30% of calls at matched utility and transfer across task families.

external_reviews.finding: Adaptive stopping and budget-conditioned control are already active mechanisms: TacoMAS permits a meta-controller to stop test-time co-evolution, BAGEN learns budget-aware early stopping, and VRR-Stop chooses repair versus commitment from estimated marginal gain under verifier and repair noise. The surviving novelty must therefore be explicitly about persistent cross-episode updates, rollback, and frozen transfer of a learned controller across evolution processes—not generic stop-or-continue control. ([arXiv][2])
external_reviews.required_action: Construct a counterfactually evaluable replay dataset for one persistent update surface in which continue, commit, rollback, and stop decisions can be compared from the same evolution state without regenerating different candidate sequences.

closest_work.title: TacoMAS: Test-Time Co-Evolution of Topology and Capability in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?
Verify, Repair, Repeat, or Stop? Robust Stopping for Noisy Verify-Repair Loops in LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A compact learned policy controlling persistent harness evolution across episodes, including rollback to prior committed versions and frozen transfer across task families; the closest work primarily controls inference-time trajectories, repair loops, or task-conditioned multi-agent adaptation.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Oracle-tuned fixed patience together with a VRR-Stop-style marginal-gain rule and a BAGEN-style learned early-stop classifier, all receiving the same logged state features, candidates, and evaluation budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate and cache candidate update branches once for ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite, train the controller only on one family, and compare frozen continue-rollback-stop decisions against fixed patience and marginal-gain rules before evaluating unchanged on AgentBench.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the controller does not save at least 30% of total candidate-generation and evaluation calls at no more than a one-point absolute utility loss on the second model and second domain, or if rollback performs no better than retaining the best historical checkpoint.
unknowns: Whether counterfactual outcomes for rejected or rolled-back updates can be obtained without spending enough additional calls to erase the claimed savings.
Whether marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost are observable before the decision rather than computed using post-decision evaluations.
Whether WebArena-Lite interaction cost and latency are compatible with the stated 18 GPU-hour pilot.

external_reviews.finding: Versioned resources, lineage, rollback, inactive branches, and whole-memory semantic rollback already exist. The potentially surviving contribution is narrower: estimating a causally sufficient minimal subset of interacting commits whose removal repairs a regression while preserving unrelated accumulated gains.
external_reviews.required_action: Reformulate the work around causal minimal-set rollback with explicit dependency identification, interaction handling, and a ground-truth rollback benchmark rather than around lineage storage.

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Causal identification of a minimum interacting rollback set across prompt, memory, workflow, and small-module commits, evaluated by repaired regression and preserved cumulative gain rather than by restoration to one historical snapshot.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Autogenesis-style latest-good snapshot rollback plus equal-budget greedy leave-one-commit-out and pairwise disable-replay search.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct 12-commit prompt, memory, and workflow sequences containing preregistered single-cause and two-way interaction regressions; compare minimal-set recovery precision, repaired success, retained pre-regression gain, and replay cost against global rollback, greedy ablation, and exhaustive search where tractable.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the inferred rollback set fails to recover the planted causes or does not preserve more accumulated held-out gain than global and greedy rollback on the second model and domain under matched replay calls.
unknowns: The dependency-edge estimator, treatment of higher-order interactions, and optimization objective for minimal rollback are unspecified.
No official evidence establishes that hierarchical disable-replay can identify causal rollback sets from the proposed low-resource number of executions.
The semantics of reverting dependent updates whose descendants have already been modified are undefined.

external_reviews.finding: Selecting tasks near the learner's success boundary is established curriculum learning, while WebRL and Socratic-SWE already generate tasks from current failures and adapt them to the solver's evolving capability frontier. The surviving opportunity is specifically to test adjacent-checkpoint discriminativeness as a cheaper, gradient-free estimator of future out-of-loop learning value.
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the generic frontier claim with a formally defined adjacent-checkpoint discrimination score and directly test whether it predicts held-out improvement better than success probability, failure replay, and validation-gradient alignment.

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A gradient-free task-value estimator based on behavioral disagreement between adjacent persistent agent versions, provided that it predicts out-of-loop gain rather than merely selecting medium-difficulty tasks.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Socratic-SWE solver-gradient alignment adapted to the same update surface, together with WebRL-style failure generation and a ProCuRL success-probability frontier.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate one common candidate-task pool, score every task by adjacent-checkpoint discrimination, current success probability, failure provenance, and validation-gradient alignment where available, then train equal-size updates and compare gain per accepted task on frozen ID and OOD evaluations using identical generation and execution budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if checkpoint discrimination has no stronger rank correlation with held-out gain than success-probability or gradient-alignment scores, or if its selected curriculum fails to improve gain per task on the second model and domain.

finding.zh: 错误归因会把偶然相关固化为长期规则，是记忆、技能、Prompt 和策略更新的共同上游问题。
finding.en: Wrong attribution turns coincidence into persistent rules across memory, skills, prompts, and policies.

finding.zh: 覆盖 3 类任务域。

finding.zh: 因果准入应提高未来任务收益并降低有害 commit。
finding.en: Causal admission should improve future-task utility and reduce harmful commits.

finding.zh: 必须逐轮报告收益、最坏回退和被拒绝更新。
finding.en: Must report gain, worst regression, and rejected updates after every round.

finding.zh: 环境真值、工具执行或异构 Critic 必须提供独立证据。

finding.zh: 上限 2 GPU、40 GPU 小时。
finding.en: Cap: 2 GPUs and 40 GPU-hours.

external_reviews.finding: The proposal recombines same-state counterfactual rule editing, replay-gated retention of candidate skill patches, and explicit memory admission control. Requiring stability to irrelevant changes is an additional acceptance test, not a sufficiently new problem-mechanism pair for a standalone ICLR thesis.
external_reviews.required_action: Replace source-task causal admission with a mechanistically distinct cross-task transportability certificate that predicts whether a lesson's effect survives task-family shift, and compare it directly against SCORE, SkillCAT, and A-MAC.

closest_work.title: SCORE: Training-Free Agent Adaptation via Same-State Counterfactual Rule Editing
SkillCAT: Contrastive Assessment and Topology-Aware Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
Adaptive Memory Admission Control For LLM Agents

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: SkillCAT's replay-gated candidate-patch evolution augmented with A-MAC admission scoring.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: With one frozen actor on ALFWorld, compare the proposed two-gate admission rule against SCORE, SkillCAT, and A-MAC using identical source trajectories, accepted-memory count, replay calls, and test-time calls, then evaluate a disjoint task family.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the method does not reduce harmful committed lessons by at least 20% relative to the strongest baseline at equal useful-lesson retention on the second model and a disjoint task family.
unknowns: SCORE was an ACL ARR May 2026 submission rather than a verified final proceeding by the cutoff.
Official sources do not establish that SCORE or SkillCAT tests invariance to explicitly irrelevant perturbations before every persistent update.

discovery.zh: 每个主域 100–200 个训练样本，只确认现象。

test.zh: 官方测试集或至少 500 个隔离样本；测试期间禁止修改更新规则。

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。

success_gate.en: Both open models and at least two domains beat the strongest equal-budget baseline without increasing worst-case regression.

stop_gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Causal admission should improve future-task utility and reduce harmful commits.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

purpose.zh: Reward 对语义无关格式、背景或表述敏感时，Agent 会优化捷径。
purpose.en: Agents exploit shortcuts when rewards respond to semantically irrelevant format, background, or phrasing.

core_idea.zh: 用语义保持、语义改变正对照和捷径探针三类 matched interventions 测选择性不变性。
core_idea.en: Use matched semantics-preserving, semantics-changing positive controls, and shortcut probes to measure selective invariance.

rationale.zh: Actor 与 Reward/Critic 共进化会形成确认偏差和代理目标过优化；评价器更新必须用独立证据治理。
rationale.en: Co-evolving actors and evaluators creates confirmation bias and proxy overoptimization; evaluator updates need independent evidence.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“用语义保持、语义改变正对照和捷径探针三类 matched interventions 测选择性不变性。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Use matched semantics-preserving, semantics-changing positive controls, and shortcut probes to measure selective invariance., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 反馈完整性决定所有自训练闭环是否可信。

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“冻结 Reward、同模型自评、独立 Reward、自进化 Reward、人工小样本校准、多 Judge。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Frozen rewards, same-model self-evaluation, independent rewards, self-evolved rewards, small human calibration, and judge ensembles., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: Constrained RLHF 研究过优化；本方法提供跨任务域、无需训练的干预诊断。
collision_boundary.en: Constrained RLHF studies overoptimization; this provides cross-domain intervention diagnostics without training.

hypothesis.en: Reliable rewards should be invariant to irrelevant changes, sensitive to semantic changes, and predictive of real selection errors.

external_reviews.finding: Selective invariance to neutral changes, sensitivity to causal changes, shortcut probes, and downstream selection validation are directly covered by recent reward-model robustness work. As written, this is a training-free diagnostic suite rather than an identifiable persistent-learning contribution.
external_reviews.required_action: Do not advance the audit as the thesis; pivot to a learned reward-update mechanism that uses independently certified causal and neutral interventions and demonstrates improved downstream policy selection over CROME and PRISM.

closest_work.title: Robust Reward Modeling via Causal Rubrics
Reward Under Attack: Analyzing the Robustness and Hackability of Process Reward Models
Rectifying Shortcut Behaviors in Preference-based Reward Learning

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: CROME causal/neutral augmentations together with the Reward Under Attack perturbation diagnostic.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On a fixed GSM8K best-of-N candidate pool, compare whether the proposed audit score predicts ground-truth selection errors beyond CROME-style causal/neutral tests and Reward Under Attack perturbation scores using identical reward-model calls.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the audit adds less than 0.03 AUROC for predicting actual best-of-N selection errors over the strongest diagnostic baseline on either of two reward models, or if its invariance score is not associated with downstream selection quality.
unknowns: No official source verifies that the proposed cross-domain transformations for GSM8K, ALFWorld, and MM-Vet are genuinely semantics-preserving without independent labels.
Reward Under Attack focuses on process reward models for reasoning; its coverage of tool and multimodal evaluators is not established.

external_reviews.finding: The proposal is directly covered as an audit rather than a learning mechanism. Correction and Corruption formalizes self-correction through separate error-repair and correct-answer-corruption rates, CorrectBench evaluates repeated correction across reasoning and code settings, and SCoRe already studies behavioral collapse during self-correction training. Adding counterfactual sensitivity is an incremental diagnostic unless it controls a new persistent update and demonstrates predictive value beyond these existing interfaces.
external_reviews.required_action: Terminate the standalone detector thesis and incorporate counterfactual sensitivity only as an ablation or gating signal inside a distinct persistent self-correction learning method.

external_reviews.finding: The problem-mechanism pair is substantially covered by work available before the cutoff. InT identifies an erroneous step, proposes a single-step intervention, verifies successful counterfactual continuations, and persists the intervention through training. REFLECT performs diagnosis-specific, prefix-preserving replay and treats a verified outcome flip as evidence for error attribution. Minimal intervention plus directional outcome validation is therefore not a surviving standalone mechanism, and extending it across text, tools, and multimodal tasks is primarily an experimental expansion.
external_reviews.required_action: Reframe the work as a failure-analysis benchmark that identifies settings where InT and REFLECT-style controlled replay produce invalid correction credit under matched intervention and rollout budgets.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: InT single-step interventions combined with REFLECT-style prefix-preserving replay and outcome-flip verification, using the same candidate corrections, tool calls, and rollout budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Collect matched GSM8K and ALFWorld failures, compare free-form critique, CRITIC, InT, REFLECT replay, and the proposed directional-consistency filter using identical candidate interventions and rollouts, then persist accepted corrections in the same memory or sub-50M adapter and test transfer to held-out task templates.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the proposed filter does not improve accepted-correction precision and held-out transfer over the InT-plus-REFLECT baseline on the second model or domain at identical intervention, tool-call, rollout, and training budgets.

test.zh: 官方测试集或至少 500 个隔离样本；测试期间禁止修改更新规则。

controls.zh: 等预算随机更新／拒绝。

controls.zh: 隐藏真值 Oracle 上界。

purpose.en: After workflow search finds a better graph, it is unclear which node, edge, or parallel structure caused the gain.

rationale.zh: 工作流是冻结基础模型时最灵活的学习表面，但搜索结果缺少结构信用、组合稳定性和圈外证据。

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“对局部图编辑做 matched ablation，学习节点、边和交互项的结构信用。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。

external_reviews.finding: The standalone problem-mechanism pair is substantially covered. JudgeFlow assigns responsibility scores to problematic workflow blocks and uses them to target subsequent edits; Learning to Compose estimates counterfactual marginal contributions of workflow capabilities; and Sherlock uses counterfactual workflow analysis to identify failure-prone nodes. Replacing these estimators with matched local ablations is a measurement refinement, not a distinct learning thesis.
external_reviews.required_action: Merge branch credit into compositional-update-compatibility as its attribution and evaluation subsystem and stop advancing it as a standalone paper.

Learning to Compose for Cross-domain Agentic Workflow Generation
Sherlock: Reliable and Efficient Agentic Workflow Execution

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: JudgeFlow with its block judge augmented by exact counterfactual node and edge ablations, matched to the same workflow executions, evaluator calls, and optimization budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On a fixed collection of AFlow-generated workflows, compare the proposed credit estimator with JudgeFlow plus exact local ablations for predicting the best next edit and reducing evaluations-to-target under identical call budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the method does not reduce evaluations-to-target by at least 20% over JudgeFlow plus exact ablations on both a second model and a second domain while preserving final task success.

title.zh: 世界模型误差门控学习

track.zh: 世界模型与具身持续适应

purpose.zh: 更准的世界模型不一定改变决策，盲目写入所有转移会增加训练噪声。
purpose.en: A more accurate world model may not improve decisions, and learning every transition adds noise.

core_idea.zh: 只学习那些预测误差会改变动作选择、风险或恢复决策的转移。
core_idea.en: Learn only transition errors that would change action selection, risk, or recovery decisions.

rationale.zh: Agent 需要学习动作后的状态变化、不可逆后果和恢复边界，但更准的模型不一定改善决策。
rationale.en: Agents need action-conditioned dynamics, irreversible outcomes, and recovery boundaries, yet accuracy may not improve decisions.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“只学习那些预测误差会改变动作选择、风险或恢复决策的转移。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。

importance.zh: 世界模型把语言反思推进到可验证环境动态学习，并连接 Web、GUI 与具身场景。
importance.en: World models move reflection toward verifiable dynamics learning across web, GUI, and embodied settings.

comparative_advantage.en: Compared with No world model, verbal reflection, WMA, one-step transitions, tree search, and random risk penalties., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: WMA 提升预测并改善策略选择；本方法治理哪些预测误差值得学习。
collision_boundary.en: WMA improves predictions and policy selection; this governs which prediction errors deserve learning.

hypothesis.en: Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.

external_reviews.finding: This is a direct restatement of decision-, value-, and policy-aware model learning. Prior work explicitly argues that globally accurate transition prediction is unnecessary and optimizes model updates toward value-relevant or policy-relevant transitions; recent work also studies calibration of such objectives. Adding action-selection, risk, and recovery decisions to web or GUI agents is a domain application unless it introduces a formally distinct objective or identifiability result.
external_reviews.required_action: Stop the standalone idea and reframe it only if a formally distinct, calibrated action-rank-change objective for LLM world models can be defined and evaluated with independent intervention ground truth.

setup.zh: 移除持久状态并匹配推理预算，排除更多采样、检索和重排。
setup.en: Remove persistent state and match inference budgets to exclude extra sampling, retrieval, and reranking.

gate.zh: 若移除更新后收益仍在，则不属于持续学习。
gate.en: If gains remain after removing the update, the effect is not persistent learning.

setup.zh: 在 WebArena-Lite、AndroidWorld、LIBERO 上，以 2 GPU、38 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
setup.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on WebArena-Lite, AndroidWorld, LIBERO with two open models and at least two domains within 2 GPUs and 38 GPU-hours.

gate.zh: 决策价值门控应以更少更新获得同等或更高任务收益。
gate.en: Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若“决策价值门控应以更少更新获得同等或更高任务收益。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

controls.zh: 无持久更新，匹配推理预算。
controls.en: No persistent update with matched inference budget.

controls.zh: 全部接受或仅按当前任务收益接受。
controls.en: Accept all updates or filter only by current-task gain.

controls.zh: 无世界模型、语言反思、WMA、一步转移模型、树搜索、随机风险惩罚。
controls.en: No world model, verbal reflection, WMA, one-step transitions, tree search, and random risk penalties.

controls.zh: 等预算随机更新／拒绝。
controls.en: Equal-budget random update/rejection.

controls.zh: 隐藏真值 Oracle 上界。
controls.en: Hidden-ground-truth oracle ceiling.

repetitions.zh: 三个随机种子；报告均值、标准差和样本级 bootstrap 95% CI。
repetitions.en: Three seeds with mean, standard deviation, and sample-level bootstrap 95% CIs.

call_budget.zh: 记录环境交互、模型调用、token、工具调用、候选更新和被拒绝更新。
call_budget.en: Report environment interactions, model calls, tokens, tool calls, candidate updates, and rejected updates.

compute_budget.zh: 上限 2 GPU、38 GPU 小时、8 天。

main_table.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
main_table.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

ablations.zh: 移除归因／回归门控。
移除圈外测试。
同架构 Critic 替代异构 Critic。
ablations.en: Replace heterogeneous critic with actor family.

ablations.zh: 不匹配调用与算力预算。

success_gate.zh: 两个开放模型、至少两个任务域均优于最强等预算 baseline，且最坏回退不增加。
success_gate.en: Both open models and at least two domains beat the strongest equal-budget baseline without increasing worst-case regression.

stop_gate.zh: 若“决策价值门控应以更少更新获得同等或更高任务收益。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

purpose.zh: 记忆被永久保留，即使环境、工具或偏好已经变化。
purpose.en: Memories persist even after environments, tools, or preferences change.

core_idea.zh: 根据跨任务帮助率、冲突率和漂移证据估计半衰期，触发复验、衰减或删除。
core_idea.en: Estimate half-life from cross-task benefit, conflict, and drift evidence, triggering revalidation, decay, or deletion.

rationale.zh: 持久记忆需要识别干扰、保存反例、表达适用边界，并随任务漂移修订。
rationale.en: Persistent memory must detect interference, retain counterexamples, encode applicability, and adapt under drift.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“根据跨任务帮助率、冲突率和漂移证据估计半衰期，触发复验、衰减或删除。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Estimate half-life from cross-task benefit, conflict, and drift evidence, triggering revalidation, decay, or deletion., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 记忆是最常见的低资源更新表面，也是负迁移最容易被平均准确率掩盖的地方。
importance.en: Memory is the most common low-resource update surface and a major hidden source of negative transfer.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“无记忆、FIFO、相似度检索、摘要记忆、固定技能库、随机删除。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with No memory, FIFO, similarity retrieval, summary memory, fixed skill libraries, and random deletion., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: 选择性遗忘已有启发式，但帮助/伤害驱动的半衰期仍不足。
collision_boundary.en: Selective forgetting has heuristics, but benefit/harm-driven half-life remains underexplored.

hypothesis.zh: 半衰期应比 recency/FIFO 更快删除过期记忆并保留长期有效规则。
hypothesis.en: Half-life should remove stale memories faster than recency/FIFO while retaining durable rules.

strongest_baseline.zh: 无记忆、FIFO、相似度检索、摘要记忆、固定技能库、随机删除。
strongest_baseline.en: No memory, FIFO, similarity retrieval, summary memory, fixed skill libraries, and random deletion.

external_reviews.finding: The problem-mechanism pair is directly occupied. MemoryBank already implements importance- and time-dependent forgetting and reinforcement; later work studies selective deletion under task-distribution shift; SF-AMS replaces heuristic decay with utility-driven survival; and Forget to Improve explicitly scores memory by value minus harm under stale-memory and task-drift conditions. Reparameterizing these signals as a half-life is not an identifiable new learning contribution. ([arXiv][3])
external_reviews.required_action: Stop standalone method development and merge the idea into a controlled benchmark of memory-staleness hazard estimation with intervention-derived ground truth.

How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
Forget to Improve: On-Device LLM-Agent Continual Learning via Budget-Curated Memory

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: SF-AMS utility-driven survival combined with Forget-to-Improve net-value curation, with MemoryBank supplying the fixed forgetting-curve anchor.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In a piecewise-stationary ALFWorld or AndroidWorld stream, compare the proposed half-life estimator with SF-AMS, net-value curation, fixed decay, and FIFO at identical memory capacity, retrieval calls, revalidation calls, and task order.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the method does not outperform both SF-AMS and net-value curation on stale-memory harm and durable-rule retention on the second model and domain, or if any gain is explained by a larger effective memory or additional revalidation calls.
unknowns: Whether SF-AMS and Forget to Improve will have complete public implementations suitable for exact reproduction.
Whether durable rules and stale memories can be labeled independently of the same downstream evaluator used to tune the half-life.
Whether AndroidWorld, ALFWorld, and HotpotQA expose comparable forms of environmental or preference drift.

external_reviews.finding: The stated collision boundary is obsolete by the review cutoff. SCoRe trains a multi-turn correction policy; InT localizes faulty reasoning and inserts targeted corrective interventions; reset-based policy optimization resamples counterfactual continuations from localized states to assign credit; and VerlTool assigns learning signals across multi-turn tool interactions. Typed correction actions and cost pruning are useful experimental factors, but they do not rescue the generic claim of local counterfactual correction credit as a new mechanism. ([OpenReview][5])
external_reviews.required_action: Stop standalone method development and reframe the contribution as a benchmark of typed correction-action attribution with executable leave-one-action-out intervention ground truth.

Credit Assignment with Resets in Language Model Reasoning
VerlTool: Towards Holistic Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Tool Use

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Self-Reset Policy Optimization for localized counterfactual continuations combined with VerlTool-style tool-interaction credit and the SCoRe two-turn correction policy.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Build fixed-prefix correction trees in which checking, resampling, tool use, and local rewrite actions are independently removed or replaced, compare estimated credits with their measured leave-one-action-out effects, and test whether pruning low-credit actions preserves success under identical rollout budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if estimated credits have held-out Spearman correlation below 0.5 with intervention effects or if removing the lowest-credit actions fails to save at least 20% of correction calls while limiting success loss to one absolute point on both the second model and second domain.
unknowns: Whether removing one correction action leaves a semantically valid continuation rather than changing all downstream states.
Whether one action taxonomy can be applied consistently to HumanEval, ALFWorld, and MM-Vet.
Whether independent executable verifiers exist for all domains without using the same critic that produces the proposed credit.
Whether multi-domain policy training and counterfactual rollouts fit within the stated 24 GPU-hours.

gate.zh: 动作级信用应减少无效纠正调用而保持修复率。
gate.en: Action-level credit should remove ineffective correction calls while preserving repair.

setup.zh: 冻结 P1 决定，迁移到第二模型、第二任务域并运行至少三轮。
setup.en: Freeze P1 choices, transfer to a second model/domain, and run at least three rounds.

gate.zh: 若“动作级信用应减少无效纠正调用而保持修复率。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Action-level credit should remove ineffective correction calls while preserving repair.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

controls.zh: 无持久更新，匹配推理预算。
controls.en: No persistent update with matched inference budget.

controls.zh: 全部接受或仅按当前任务收益接受。
controls.en: Accept all updates or filter only by current-task gain.

controls.zh: 再次采样、Self-Refine、独立 Critic、离线 SFT、固定两轮纠正、多数投票。
controls.en: Resampling, Self-Refine, independent critics, offline SFT, fixed two-pass correction, and majority vote.

controls.zh: 等预算随机更新／拒绝。
controls.en: Equal-budget random update/rejection.

controls.zh: 隐藏真值 Oracle 上界。
controls.en: Hidden-ground-truth oracle ceiling.

repetitions.zh: 三个随机种子；报告均值、标准差和样本级 bootstrap 95% CI。
repetitions.en: Three seeds with mean, standard deviation, and sample-level bootstrap 95% CIs.

call_budget.zh: 记录环境交互、模型调用、token、工具调用、候选更新和被拒绝更新。
call_budget.en: Report environment interactions, model calls, tokens, tool calls, candidate updates, and rejected updates.

compute_budget.zh: 上限 1 GPU、24 GPU 小时、5 天。

main_table.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
main_table.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

ablations.zh: 移除归因／回归门控。
移除圈外测试。
同架构 Critic 替代异构 Critic。
ablations.en: Replace heterogeneous critic with actor family.

ablations.zh: 不匹配调用与算力预算。

success_gate.zh: 两个开放模型、至少两个任务域均优于最强等预算 baseline，且最坏回退不增加。
success_gate.en: Both open models and at least two domains beat the strongest equal-budget baseline without increasing worst-case regression.

stop_gate.zh: 若“动作级信用应减少无效纠正调用而保持修复率。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_gate.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Action-level credit should remove ineffective correction calls while preserving repair.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

purpose.zh: 在线课程改变策略分布，旧 Reward 和任务生成器随迭代失配。
purpose.en: Online curricula shift policy distributions, making rewards and task generators stale.

core_idea.zh: 用固定锚点和行为分布距离监测漂移，并触发 replay、减小更新或停止。
core_idea.en: Monitor drift with frozen anchors and behavioral distance, triggering replay, smaller updates, or stopping.

rationale.zh: 从失败生成新任务可推进能力边界，也会造成重复、难度膨胀、标签污染和策略漂移。
rationale.en: Failure-generated tasks can move the frontier but also create duplication, difficulty inflation, contamination, and drift.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“用固定锚点和行为分布距离监测漂移，并触发 replay、减小更新或停止。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Monitor drift with frozen anchors and behavioral distance, triggering replay, smaller updates, or stopping., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: WebRL 展示了自进化课程的潜力；关键空缺是何时产生真实圈外泛化。
importance.en: WebRL shows the potential of evolving curricula; the key question is when they yield out-of-loop generalization.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“静态数据、随机重采样、失败重放、难度课程、WebRL 式生成、等量人工任务。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Static data, random resampling, failure replay, difficulty curricula, WebRL-style generation, and equal-size human tasks., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: WebRL 控制训练漂移，但缺少跨方法统一、可审计的课程漂移指标。
collision_boundary.en: WebRL controls training drift but lacks a unified, auditable curriculum-drift metric.

hypothesis.zh: 漂移信号应在锚点退化前预测回退。
hypothesis.en: Drift signals should predict regression before anchor degradation.

strongest_baseline.en: Static data, random resampling, failure replay, difficulty curricula, WebRL-style generation, and equal-size human tasks.

external_reviews.finding: The proposal combines mechanisms already demonstrated separately and jointly: WebRL explicitly controls policy-distribution drift with adaptive updates and replay, Library Drift supplies pre-regression diagnostics and lifecycle interventions, and PACE supplies a statistically controlled stop-or-commit gate. A unified drift score is not, by itself, an identifiable new learning contribution.
external_reviews.required_action: Stop this as a standalone thesis and retain it only as an evaluation or governance component inside an idea with a genuinely new update mechanism.

external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the proposed signal does not predict held-out regression earlier than anchor-score degradation on both models and domains, or if Library Drift plus PACE matches its retained performance under the same call and update budgets.

external_reviews.finding: CLEAR and MemCollab already contrast multiple trajectories for the same task to distill reusable context or task-level invariants while suppressing trajectory-specific artifacts. Restricting the pool to trajectories with the same endpoint does not create a new credit signal, because endpoint equivalence neither establishes process validity nor identifies which shared behavior caused success.
external_reviews.required_action: Stop the proposal as stated and only reopen it after replacing outcome matching with independently verified counterfactual process interventions that yield identifiable invariance evidence.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: MemCollab same-task contrastive trajectory distillation, supplemented by CLEAR multi-trajectory reflection, with identical rollout counts and memory-token budgets.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: For each ALFWorld task, collect a fixed number of successful trajectories and matched mixed-outcome trajectories, extract lessons with the proposed intersection rule and with MemCollab or CLEAR, and evaluate frozen transfer to state-perturbed task variants under identical trajectory-generation, reflection, retrieval, and token budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if success-success contrast does not outperform mixed-outcome contrastive distillation on held-out perturbations, or if any gain disappears after matching the number of generated trajectories and retained memory tokens.

success_gate.zh: 两个开放模型、至少两个任务域均优于最强等预算 baseline，且最坏回退不增加。

title.zh: 带适用边界的经验学习

purpose.zh: 自然语言经验被过度泛化到表面相似但约束不同的状态。
purpose.en: Natural-language lessons are overgeneralized to superficially similar states with different constraints.

core_idea.zh: 每条经验同时保存支持条件、最小反例和弃权区域。
core_idea.en: Store support conditions, minimal counterexamples, and abstention regions with every lesson.

rationale.zh: 成功或失败轨迹不能直接说明哪条经验真正导致结果；需要 matched replay 和局部干预。
rationale.en: Success or failure does not identify the causal lesson; matched replay and local intervention are required.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“每条经验同时保存支持条件、最小反例和弃权区域。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Store support conditions, minimal counterexamples, and abstention regions with every lesson., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 错误归因会把偶然相关固化为长期规则，是记忆、技能、Prompt 和策略更新的共同上游问题。
importance.en: Wrong attribution turns coincidence into persistent rules across memory, skills, prompts, and policies.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“按成功写入、语言 Critic、模型置信度、轨迹级消融、随机拒绝。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Success-only admission, language critics, confidence, trajectory ablation, and random rejection., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: AgentRefine 改善纠错泛化，但不显式维护每条持久经验的适用域。
collision_boundary.en: AgentRefine improves refinement generalization but does not explicitly maintain lesson applicability.

hypothesis.zh: 带边界经验应保持正迁移，同时减少跨任务错误调用。
hypothesis.en: Bounded lessons should preserve positive transfer while reducing erroneous cross-task invocation.

strongest_baseline.zh: 按成功写入、语言 Critic、模型置信度、轨迹级消融、随机拒绝。
strongest_baseline.en: Success-only admission, language critics, confidence, trajectory ablation, and random rejection.

decisive_metric.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。

external_reviews.finding: Assay directly addresses lessons or skills that help some tasks and harm superficially related ones: it measures per-skill causal heterogeneity, splits skills into conditional variants with explicit triggers, and suppresses predicted-harmful skills per task. RaMem independently stores contextual validity conditions and performs validity-aware retrieval. Adding support text, counterexamples, and abstention fields is therefore a representation change rather than a distinct learning mechanism.
external_reviews.required_action: Stop this standalone idea and merge its counterexample or abstention representation into an Assay-class causal skill-selection baseline unless a formal calibrated support-set learner can be specified.

closest_work.title: Not All Skills Help: Measuring and Repairing Agent Knowledge
RaMem: Contextual Reinstatement for Long-term Agentic Memory
SkillMAS: Skill Co-Evolution with LLM-based Multi-Agent System

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Assay conditional skill splitting and per-task causal masking with the same learned lesson library, development set, retrieval budget, and foundation model.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Create paired tasks that are semantically similar but differ by one applicability constraint, learn lessons from one side, and compare unbounded retrieval, explicit-condition prompting, RaMem-style validity retrieval, Assay causal masking, and the proposed representation on positive transfer, harmful invocation rate, selective risk, coverage, and total calls.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the method does not reduce harmful cross-task invocation beyond Assay at matched coverage and calls, or if its apparent advantage is reproduced by appending ordinary trigger conditions to each lesson.

title.zh: 异构 Critic 分歧学习

purpose.zh: Actor 与同架构 Critic 容易共享盲点，表面一致不能证明正确。
purpose.en: Actors and same-family critics share blind spots, so agreement is not correctness.

core_idea.en: Use cross-architecture critic disagreement for learning only when environment or tool ground truth can resolve it.

rationale.zh: 第二次回答更好不等于学会纠正；必须区分额外采样、外部 Critic 和 on-policy 纠错内化。
rationale.en: A better second answer is not learned correction; extra sampling, external critics, and on-policy internalization must be separated.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“只把可由环境或工具真值裁决的跨架构 Critic 分歧用于更新。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Use cross-architecture critic disagreement for learning only when environment or tool ground truth can resolve it., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

importance.zh: 自纠正是低资源自进化的重要路径，但最容易被更多推理计算伪装。
importance.en: Self-correction is a key low-resource path but is easily confounded by extra inference.

comparative_advantage.zh: 相较于“再次采样、Self-Refine、独立 Critic、离线 SFT、固定两轮纠正、多数投票。”，该机制直接检验更新是否产生持久、可归因且稳定的圈外收益。
comparative_advantage.en: Compared with Resampling, Self-Refine, independent critics, offline SFT, fixed two-pass correction, and majority vote., the mechanism directly tests whether updates yield persistent, attributable, stable out-of-loop gains.

collision_boundary.zh: Critic-V 使用独立 Critic；跨架构分歧何时成为可靠学习信号仍不明确。
collision_boundary.en: Critic-V uses an independent critic; when cross-family disagreement becomes reliable supervision is still unclear.

hypothesis.zh: 可裁决分歧应比全量 critique 具有更高监督精度。
hypothesis.en: Resolvable disagreements should provide higher supervision precision than all critiques.

strongest_baseline.zh: 再次采样、Self-Refine、独立 Critic、离线 SFT、固定两轮纠正、多数投票。
strongest_baseline.en: Resampling, Self-Refine, independent critics, offline SFT, fixed two-pass correction, and majority vote.

pilot.zh: 在 GSM8K、ALFWorld、MM-Vet 上，以 2 GPU、32 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
pilot.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on GSM8K, ALFWorld, MM-Vet with two open models and at least two domains within 2 GPUs and 32 GPU-hours.

decisive_metric.zh: Future-task gain、Worst regression、Update-admission precision、Out-of-loop generalization 与单位交互/调用/GPU 收益。
decisive_metric.en: Future-task gain, worst regression, update-admission precision, out-of-loop generalization, and gain per interaction/call/GPU-hour.

stop_condition.zh: 若“可裁决分歧应比全量 critique 具有更高监督精度。”在第二模型或第二任务域不成立，或收益仅来自更多调用，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the hypothesis—Resolvable disagreements should provide higher supervision precision than all critiques.—fails on the second model/domain or gains come only from extra calls.

budget.training: Freeze the foundation model; update only prompts, memory, workflows, routers, or modules below 50M parameters.

finding.zh: Critic-V 使用独立 Critic；跨架构分歧何时成为可靠学习信号仍不明确。
finding.en: Critic-V uses an independent critic; when cross-family disagreement becomes reliable supervision is still unclear.

finding.zh: 自纠正是低资源自进化的重要路径，但最容易被更多推理计算伪装。
